description: Manage caller-owned agents and conversations through the V3 owning APIs, with live tenant authority and exact revisions. Session watches use the installed Automation service.

settings.label: Allow Session Watching
settings.hint: Whether an agent can arm a session watch (watch_sessions), which triggers it when one of your sessions settles — a turn that was running stops. When off, the tool refuses platform-wide. Note this only controls ARMING: the agent still needs the Automation ability enabled for the platform to deliver the events. Per-agent control is the normal tool permission dial — deny watch_sessions on every agent except the one you want watching.

migration_note: Native V3 implementation. Current schemas, live policy and configured model/module availability determine callable behavior.
